entry.title: Lab Drop #1: what happens after a pump.fun coin hits $100k
entry.summary: We followed pump.fun graduates that crossed a $100k market cap. About 1 in 5 were still at $100k a day later. Four ways we tried to trade it all lost money after costs. Research, not advice. NFA, DYOR.
